Select IC50 activities against human EGFR (CHEMBL203) with full provenance and structures. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join docs on activities.doc_id. Join compound_structures on molregno as INNER JOIN. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203', target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_units = 'nM', compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, and docs.pubmed_id OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL. Return DISTINCT rows for compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
